title: WolfClan
description: A polished vanilla Minecraft experience featuring optional resource packs, proximity voice chat, and quality-of-life improvements, all designed to foster a friendly and long-lasting community.
body:
🐺 WolfClan SMP
A polished vanilla Minecraft experience, built around community.

WolfClan SMP is a carefully curated survival server that stays true to the core Minecraft experience while introducing a selection of high-quality enhancements designed to improve immersion, accessibility, and long-term gameplay.

Rather than relying on large gameplay modifications, WolfClan focuses on features that naturally complement vanilla Minecraft, including optional resource packs, proximity voice chat, quality-of-life improvements, custom events, and an actively maintained server environment.

🌟 Project Highlights,
Vanilla-first gameplay philosophy,
Optional immersive resource pack,
Proximity Voice Chat support,
Fair economy and balanced progression,
Active moderation and player support,
Community events and seasonal content,
Regular updates and continuous improvements.
💙 Built for Players.

WolfClan is designed for players who value a friendly community, long-term survival, and a stable server where every feature has a purpose. Every update is carefully planned to enhance the experience while preserving the creativity, exploration, and freedom that make Minecraft unique.

Whether you're building your first home or your largest project yet, WolfClan provides a welcoming place to play, collaborate, and create lasting memories.
